hero.title: Federation Services
hero.subtitle: & Accreditation
hero.desc: Supporting athletes, state bodies, certified officials, and strength gyms nationwide through structured accreditation, sanctioning, referee clinics, and equipment logistics.

services.title: Athlete Sanctioning & National IPF ID
services.desc: Issuance of the official digital National Athlete Card, permanent IPF identification number, anti-doping verification, and verified inclusion in the national ranking database.
features: Official National Competitor License valid across all states
Automatic inclusion in the live national leaderboard & records eligibility
NADA clean sport profile and digital verification QR code
Annual renewal and category transfer management
services.waMessage: Hi Coaches Akash & Tanvi, I would like to apply for official Athlete Sanctioning and National IPF ID.

services.title: National Referee Certification Clinics
services.desc: Comprehensive certification courses and examinations for National Category 1 & Category 2 Referees, covering rulebook mastery, hand signals, platform protocol, and practical evaluation.
features: Intensive 2-day technical theory & case-study workshop
Live platform practical judging under Senior International Referees
Official IPF referee blazer patch, rulebook, and digital credential
Eligibility to officiate at State, Zonal, and National Championships
services.timeline: Conducted bi-annually prior to National Championships
services.waMessage: Hi Coaches Akash & Tanvi, I am interested in enrolling in the upcoming National Referee Certification Clinic.

services.title: State Powerlifting Body Affiliation
services.desc: Official recognition and charter for State Powerlifting Associations, empowering state bodies to organize certified state championships, dispatch national delegates, and govern district clubs.
features: Annual state governing charter and voting assembly delegation
Official sanctioning rights for district & state championship meets
Dispatch of national certified technical delegates and jury members
Direct pipeline for state athlete qualification to Nationals
services.waMessage: Hi Coaches Akash & Tanvi, we would like to consult regarding State Association affiliation and meet sanctioning.

services.title: Gym & Club Official Affiliation
services.desc: Accreditation for private fitness centers, CrossFit boxes, and strength gyms looking to become officially certified federation training academies and represent lifters at meets.
features: Official 'Federation Certified Training Center' plaque and digital seal
Right to register and field club teams in national club championships
Equipment compliance audit and platform safety certification
Special discounts on federation coaching seminars and workshops
services.waMessage: Hi Coaches Akash & Tanvi, our gym would like to apply for official Federation Club Affiliation.

services.title: Championship Equipment & Platform Rental
services.desc: Turnkey competition hardware rental for authorized state bodies, universities, and corporate powerlifting meets, including calibrated plates, IPF combo racks, and electronic scoring boards.
features: 4m x 4m competition platform with heavy-duty carpet and shock dampening
Certified IPF combo racks and 20kg competition bars
Full 450kg+ calibrated steel plate set accurate to within ±10g
Electronic 3-light referee scoring system and projector display software
services.timeline: Available on booking with 30-day advance notice
services.waMessage: Hi Coaches Akash & Tanvi, I would like to inquire about championship platform and equipment rental for our upcoming meet.

services.title: Coaching Workshops & Masterclasses
services.desc: Accredited masterclasses led by Head Coaches Akash & Tanvi on powerlifting biomechanics, programming, peaking methodologies, and youth strength development.
features: Hands-on bar path and kinematic video analysis
Peaking cycles and water cut protocols without strength depletion
Continuing education certificate in strength & conditioning
Direct Q&A with elite national lifters and specialists
services.timeline: Quarterly workshops across major metro centers
services.waMessage: Hi Coaches Akash & Tanvi, I would like details on upcoming Federation Coaching Masterclasses.

services.title: Corporate Powerlifting & Strength League
services.desc: Custom strength leagues and inter-departmental powerlifting meets organized directly on-site for corporate campuses.
features: Official certificate issued
